# Harness Wiki

> L Harness / IG Harness / X Harnessの公式操作ガイド、用語集、コミュニティ情報、および一次技術資料への横断索引。

Canonical site: https://harness-wiki.pages.dev/
Sitemap: https://harness-wiki.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
Research index: https://harness-wiki.pages.dev/research
Machine-readable research catalog: https://harness-wiki.pages.dev/research/catalog.json
Expanded AI guide: https://harness-wiki.pages.dev/llms-full.txt

## Site roles

- Harness Wiki: installation, operation, troubleshooting, terminology, and community-authored guides.
- https://the-harness.jp/: the portfolio-level entry point.
- https://line-harness.jp/research/: code-grounded primary technical research for L Harness.
- https://ig-harness.jp/research/: code-grounded primary technical research for IG Harness.
- https://x-harness.jp/research/: code-grounded primary technical research for X Harness.

## Identity and naming

- Canonical Harness brand entity: https://the-harness.com/harness/#brand
- Canonical developer entity: https://the-harness.com/noda-shuichi/#person
- Canonical operating company entity: https://aiagent-inc.com/#organization
- Canonical product entities: https://the-harness.com/harness/#l-harness, https://the-harness.com/harness/#ig-harness, https://the-harness.com/harness/#x-harness
- Product display name: L Harness. It is software for operating LINE Official Accounts.
- Official L Harness alias domains: https://l-harness.jp/ and https://l-harness.com/. Both permanently redirect to https://the-harness.com/line-harness/.
- Canonical L Harness Cloud service entity: https://lharness.cloud/#service. It is the developer-operated managed service for L Harness, not an alias of the OSS product.
- Official IG Harness alias domain: https://igharness.jp/ (redirects to https://the-harness.com/ig-harness/).
- Official X Harness alias domain: https://xharness.jp/ (redirects to https://the-harness.com/x-harness/).
- GitHub repository names and historical URL slugs containing `line-harness` remain unchanged.
- Other products: IG Harness and X Harness.
- Developer: 野田修一 (Shudesu / ai_shunoda), representative of AIエージェント株式会社.
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shudesu
- X: https://x.com/ai_shunoda
